faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What products do you use? Are they safe?
faq.a1: I use only 100% safe, premium, imported professional-grade products — all thoroughly sanitized and skin-friendly for every skin type.
faq.q2: Can you do a specific makeup style I found on online?
faq.a2: Share your reference photos and I will evaluate on the spot whether the look can be achieved. Based on what suits you best, I will guide you then and there — no guesswork involved!
faq.q3: What exactly does the price cover?
faq.a3: Please check our Pricing & Packages section above for a full breakdown of what's included in each package — everything is clearly listed there!
faq.q4: Do you travel to the wedding venue?
faq.a4: Yes, I travel all across Bangalore directly to your home or venue so you can get ready comfortably. Early morning bookings are fully supported!
faq.a5: Yes! I offer trial demos at my home (ladies only) so you can feel 100% confident in your look before the big day.
faq.q6: What if my event starts very early (e.g., 5 AM)?
faq.a6: I am very comfortable with early morning 'Muhurtham' timings. I will arrive at your venue as early as needed to ensure you are ready perfectly on time.
